reports.desc: I ordered a wallet in June and was in contact with Customer Service several times asking about delivery. They responded that the item was in transit but did not provide any tracking information, even after requested. I finally sent an email the end of August asking for a refund and they replied since it was in transit, they could not refund. After again following up for tracking information, they have ghosted me and do not respond to emails.
He posed as a credit repair guy took my money then ghosted me im want my money back n  sue him for suffering
I received notification in the mail I am to receive unclaimed rewards; $250 shoppy gift card

It was an A.I recording of a lady claiming to be with Document Delivery Service and is scheduled to deliver some documents to my home or work address between 8am to 4pm. If they are unable to deliver the documents it would be considered an failed action to serve. Which would result in a pending matter to proceed further without my consent. They also said if I need to change my scheduled date or if I have any questions to call 1-855-612-3343.

Advertisement for modlilly swimming suits. Advertised they were on sale.  Clicked on advertisement to purchase all items. Afterwards, no C.C. confirmation, no confirmation of purchase. Nothing in email or by text.  Not received any product.
I ordered a product online and was charged twice plus charged me another amount twice  for something i didn't ask for
Attempted to get information, claiming I won $200,000

The scam letter offered me to share proceeds from the "permanent life insurance" of a supposedly dead relative whom I never heard of. The letter further stipulated that proceeds were to be split and that the process was 100% risk free.  The problems are as follows:  The letter is from a Canadian law firm soliciting business in the US (not legal), the letter came postmarked from a post office in Georgia (US) and the scammer provides a GMail address for "private" contact.

Orders shirt that was totally not the description online after investigating the company it is a common problem with no resolution. They do not let you return item for refund. After countless emails they got to a 50% refund but who is to say I will even receive that

I kept getting a bill on my PayPal to “MS” or Medical Score and it was then billed to “Effecto”. One bill for 31 $ went through in May of 26. That I did not notice.  Then they attempted to bill me 158$ in August and 89$ in September. I have no emails, no app, no correspondence from this “company” and do not recall any of it. I finally went through cancelling 2 credit cards and calling PayPal who agreed to stop billing me automatically for payment for this fraudulent company.  The website help center says they are from Lithuania. I have emailed the Help center of this “company” and asked them to “cancel my supposed “subscription” and have not heard back. Be Aware!

Got a text saying i had a delivery coming at 9 am tomorrow.  Left a number to reschedule. I called said number and was told that they were an organization trying to serve court papers on me for a lawsuit.  The details do not seem right. They recited back to me my ssn after hearing the last 2
digits of my ssn.
I placed an order and it never arrived. I emailed the company and they said they would reship it but again it never arrived and the tracking number was no good
Dave said I owed money to his collection agency for medical diagnostics lab bill from June 2025

Knowing better I did not take the bait.  I simply tried to validate the company via their phone and QR web site target.  That identification was impossible.  The use of qrto.org in QR code (personally) validated my "suspicion" that this "event" is most probably a scam for time share owners.
